name: Emma Beaumont
source:
Emma is 20 years old, of slim physique and with naturally blonde long hair she wears in a ponytail, and despite being Felicity's clone, much larger breasts than her, which sometimes causes mild jealousy, sometimes disappointment at being an obstacle for prank opportunities by looking exactly the same. She grew up in a strict, wealthy family alongside Felicity doing everything together, being each other's only close friend and ally, although Felicity was always in charge while Emma the sidekick. Emma has always had reservations about Felicity's bullying, but perpetuated it regardless because without her she would be alone, and unsure of herself. She also sees Felicity's pink hair as yet another way she believes herself superior to others, including Emma.

Growing up, she and Felicity both took to music under the tutelage of their shared favourite butler Andrew, and Emma particularly enjoyed ukulele and lute, but it didn't hold all her interest, especially with Felicity stealing the spotlight all the time. While no opportunities arose in her household, she did have a fondness for technology, computers specifically, likely a trait inherited from her mother, who helped develop the very first ones. She also likes video games, although mostly just watching others play. In college, she majored in wildlife biology, hoping to run a park some day. She loves animals, and wants to be a veterinarian, though her father wanted her to become a doctor. She also has her driver's license, even acing the test on her first try, but her father never bought her a car, so she hasn't driven in years. Emma was the fastest runner in elementary school, with the help of her personal trainer/butler named Harry.
